firstParty: Borneco official station page documents connected/OCPP-capable charging, billing and supervision.
The same first-party page contains an illustrative profitability model with electricity purchase 0.09 EUR/kWh and resale 0.35 EUR/kWh, plus operator supervision commission.
Borneco copropriété material states consumption can be billed at the real kWh tariff, confirming deployment/contract-dependent economics rather than proving one current public national CPO tariff.
secondPass.tariffInterpretation: The 0.35 EUR/kWh resale figure is a business profitability example, not sufficient evidence of a current universal public FR*BHM ad-hoc tariff.
secondPass.resolver: No anonymous deterministic first-party FR*BHM station/EVSE -> current public direct numeric tariff resolver recovered after distinct official site, station/business model and QR/public resolver searches.
